learning_profile.note: No context-aware ACTIONABLE segment was used to mechanically alter this forecast; current facts and pre-prediction context dominate.

predictions.mechanism: A fresh Saudi civil-defense threat warning, following recent attacks on regional energy infrastructure, can widen geopolitical risk premium, but no confirmed new strike is reported yet.
predictions.invalidation: Warning is lifted without incident and no follow-on attack or energy disruption occurs.

predictions.mechanism: Possible fresh Saudi security escalation can increase headline-driven risk while oil is already above $100, but the warning alone is insufficient for a clean directional call.
predictions.invalidation: No incident follows and crude/risk futures normalize toward pre-warning levels.

predictions.mechanism: Growth equities are sensitive to an energy-driven inflation/rates shock, but without a confirmed attack the highest-conviction forecast is volatility rather than direction.
predictions.invalidation: No incident follows and energy prices/rates do not extend higher.

predictions.mechanism: European cyclicals remain exposed to Middle East energy-risk headlines, though the current item is only a warning and not a confirmed supply disruption.
predictions.invalidation: The warning expires without escalation and oil retraces.

predictions.mechanism: Elevated oil and regional security risk increase headline sensitivity for European equities, but the absence of a confirmed event prevents a strong directional forecast.
predictions.invalidation: No follow-on incident and a material easing in oil/geopolitical risk premium.
